# Xenga

> On-chain USDC escrow and open credit data for humans and agents on Base. x402-compatible — any x402 agent can pay without Xenga-specific code.

## Key Capabilities

- **Escrow payments**: Lock USDC in on-chain escrow with configurable release windows, auto-release, and dispute resolution
- **Open credit data**: Portable reputation scores (0-100) derived from real escrow outcomes — completion rate, dispute rate, volume
- **x402 protocol**: Standard HTTP 402 payment flow — POST, get requirements, sign ERC-3009, retry with signature
- **Service types**: agent-service (1h), inference (5min), tool-call (1min), marketplace (7d), data-pipeline (1h)
- **Client SDK**: `escrowFetch()` drop-in fetch wrapper, `createEscrowClient()` for full lifecycle management
- **Seller dashboard**: Self-service order management, API keys, webhooks, payment links
